projects.title: IERM - Intelligent Examination Room Management System
projects.description: A multi-role examination management and AI-assisted proctoring system for managing exam scheduling, attendance, identity veri cation, ticket handling, and real-time monitoring during university examinations.

projects.title: GoHomey - Ride-Hailing Platform
projects.description: A full-stack mobile ride-hailing application built with React Native and Node.js, featuring OTP phone authentication, real-time GPS tracking, route visualization with OpenStreetMap-based services, vehicle selection, and trip management. The project integrates mapping APIs, MongoDB database storage, and RESTful backend services to simulate a modern transportation booking experience.

projects.title: Grand Hotel - Hotel Booking & Management System
projects.description: A full-stack hotel booking platform that supports hotel searching, room reservations, online payments, check-in/check-out management, refund processing, face-recognition check-in, and role-based hotel administration for customers, staff, managers, and admins.
